subject: Partner-sourced trial credit top-up negotiation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudwave.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@sysintegrate.io>
Date: 2028-09-17T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: additional promo credits for joint SI-led pilot

Jordan —

Thanks again for the intro last week. Quick ask: our SI partner (SysIntegrate) is ready to run a 6-week pilot with a strategic retail customer, but they need a partner-funded top-up to cover GPU minutes for the last two weeks when load spikes.

We'd like to request a one-time 40k token-equivalent credit (estimate attached) to be applied to the trial under a co-funded model: CloudWave will cover 50% of consumed credit and Redwood covers the remaining 50% as a marketplace promo. The customer has agreed to a post-pilot exec review for expansion.

Attachments: cloudwave_credit_request_v1.pdf (breakdown), si_proof_of_engagement.xlsx

Open to conditional terms — e.g., credits released after a short security attestation and access whitelist. LMK what info you need to escalate.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Partnerships — CloudWave Systems
liam@cloudwave.com

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@sysintegrate.io>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-17T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: additional promo credits for joint SI-led pilot

Liam —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. I've looped in Kimberly (Marketplace Ops) to confirm eligibility and Monica (Partner Ops) for the co-funding flow. High level — this looks sensible but we'll need:

- A short security attestation from the SI (one-pager) that the customer's data access is limited and logs are enabled
- A confirmed usage milestone that triggers payout (we typically do a staged release; propose 50% after week 4 usage threshold, 50% after final demo)
- A brief partner commitment (email OK) confirming CloudWave's 50% contribution

I'll surface to Marketplace for provisional approval once Kimberly confirms the classification.

Next steps: Kimberly, can you flag any hard blockers on the marketplace promo side? Monica, FYI on the co-fund routing.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-18T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: additional promo credits for joint SI-led pilot

Jordan —

Saw the request. Provisional OK from marketplace side pending:

- Verification that CloudWave is a registered marketplace reseller for this region (they are in EMEA/APAC but need US listing proof)
- The credit SKU mapping in our billing system (I can create a temporary promo token pool tied to deal RW-2028-7421)
- A signed co-fund commitment (simple email chain acceptable for now)

I can provision a 40k token pool as a hold, mark it as "conditional promo" and only convert to billable credit after the milestone triggers you suggested. Please confirm you want me to hold the pool.

- Kim
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com; kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-19T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: additional promo credits for joint SI-led pilot

Jordan / Kim —

Two quick compliance items before we move the hold to approval:

1) SI attestation content — we need explicit confirmation that no customer PII will be exported from the pilot environment and that KV caching is disabled for user identifiers. The SI attestation template is attached in my internal repo (I can paste a short checklist into the thread if they prefer).

2) Audit log retention — we require 90 days retention for any trial under a co-funded arrangement where credits are applied to a third-party account. Will the customer accept that?

If both are OK, operations can sign off and Kimberly can release the conditional hold. If either is a blocker, we should scope a smaller top-up or time-boxed allocation.

- Monica Patel
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloudwave.com>, Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@sysintegrate.io>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-21T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: additional promo credits for joint SI-led pilot — conditional approval

Liam / Aisha —

Good news: we can provisionally approve a 40k token-equivalent top-up as a conditional promo pool. Conditions to release:

- SysIntegrate provides the short SI security attestation confirming no PII export and KV caching disabled (one-paragraph plus checklist).
- Customer signs a confirmation accepting 90-day audit log retention for the trial.
- CloudWave confirms via email their 50% co-fund commitment (simple reply to this thread is fine).

Operational flow: Kimberly will place a conditional hold on the 40k pool today and will convert to active credits once Monica confirms the attestation and log acceptance. I'll also create a HubSpot milestone (Deal RW-2028-7421) to track releases.

Please reply with the attestation and the partner commitment and we'll move forward. If you prefer, I can also open a DocuSign envelope for a lightweight co-fund addendum — linking one below.

DocuSign (optional): https://www.docusign.net/Member/StartInSession.aspx?envelopeId=ABC123DEF
HubSpot tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7421

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

Jordan Blake
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
